pll2d2c2-d1e3514.summary: States that nothing, not even time, was made before the angelic nature and the confused matter of the four elements; they were created with time, not from or in time, as time was not created in time, there being no time before heaven and earth.
claims: Angels and matter were created with time.
Time was not created in time.

pll2d2c2-d1e3517.summary: Cites Augustine: God was lord before time, not beginning to be lord in time, since he was lord of time when time began, and time did not begin in time.
claims: God was lord of time when time began.

pl-l2d2c2.summary: Adds that nothing, not even time, was made before the angelic nature and the unformed matter of the four elements; they were created with time, not in time, as time was not created in time. Augustine: God was lord before time and did not begin to be lord in time, being lord of time when time began.
claims: Nothing was made before the angelic nature and unformed matter.
Angels and matter were created with time, not in time.
Time was not created in time.
